remarks: Beautiful unit in the heart of the SONO district. Completely updated kitchen with white shaker cabinets, granite countertop, stove, dishwasher and range hood and laminate flooring throughout. 9ft+ ceilings in kitchen, living room and bedroom. Washer/dryer in unit. Secure building with Elevator. Outside shared space with grill. Short walk to everything SONO has to offer: restaurants, theater, nightlife, Maritime Aquarium, shopping, train station. Short drive to Calf's Pasture beach. NO PETS and NO SMOKING.
